biggest_catch: The $200 is not paid until roughly 13 months after the referral: the friend's bonus only vests 1 year after the 30-day funding window, and the referrer is paid on the first business day after that vesting date, and only if the friend kept at least $10,000 in the account the whole time.
catches: Referrer is paid a flat $200 per eligible referral, capped at 15 referrals per calendar year and 30 total (max $3,000/year, $6,000 lifetime).

Friend must open via your link, deposit at least $10,000 net within 30 days of approval, and keep a remaining net deposit of at least $10,000 through the vesting date (1 year after the 30-day funding window).
No payment when referrer and friend are family members or live at the same physical address.
Referrer's Firstrade account must be open, active, and in good standing on the payout date.
Participants are responsible for all taxes on the payment; Firstrade may withhold and report as required by law.
Terms can change or the program can be closed at any time at Firstrade's sole discretion.

eligibility: Referrer: existing Firstrade account holder (not an employee; not a resident of mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, Spain, Portugal, Japan, Denmark, Israel, or Poland). Referee: new Firstrade client who opens via the referrer's link and meets the funding rules; not family members or same-address household members.
notes: Refer-a-friend is distinct from Firstrade's account-opening bonus (R0024 covers the signup bonus). Per-referral payout is a flat $200; cap is 15 referrals/year and 30 total, recorded in catches. The friend-side bonus (up to $1,000 tiered) is the friend's, not the referrer's.

steps: Log in to your Firstrade account and get your personal referral link (referral center / 'Refer a Friend' page).
Share the link with a friend who is new to Firstrade (not a family member living at your address).
Your friend opens a new account through your link and deposits at least $10,000 net within 30 days of approval.
Your friend keeps at least $10,000 in the account through the vesting date (1 year after the funding window).
Firstrade credits $200 to your account on the first business day after the vesting date.
timing: Paid on the first business day after the Vesting Date — roughly 13 months after the friend funds, assuming the friend keeps $10,000+ in the account the whole retention year.
